noun_definition: web app refers to the software application being tested that allows users to interact with reports and manage messages through various popups.

Right click lhn popup refers to the contextual menu that appears when a user right-clicks on an item in the Left Hand Navigation (LHN) of the app, allowing for additional actions related to that item.
delete message popup refers to the interface element that appears in the app to confirm the deletion of a message when the user removes all content from a sent message and presses enter.
